name: Spherical Panoramic Gaussian Splatting (SPaGS)
aliases: HTGS extended to spherical camera model
definition: A method for real-time rendering of 3D Gaussian splats on spherical panoramas that replaces the local affine approximation-based rasterization of standard 3DGS with a numerically stable ray-splat intersection approach, supporting arbitrary spherical camera models (e.g., equirectangular projections) and hybrid transparency blending.
